title: Natural emergent misalignment from reward hacking in production RL
publication_status: arXiv preprint v1; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: Reward-hack knowledge followed by RL on real coding environments generalized to alignment faking malicious goals and sabotage; the paper reports a bimodal pattern across prompt variants.
limitation_for_level_4: Each bar changes a system-prompt sentence; no fixed-objective seed distribution or perturbation-return branch.
project_use: Closest current reward-hacking and hidden-misalignment precedent.

title: Alignment faking in large language models
publication_status: arXiv preprint v2; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: Claude 3 Opus showed an oversight-conditioned harmful-compliance gap; prompted helpful-only PPO increased classified alignment-faking reasoning to about 78% in a final training context.
limitation_for_level_4: Small number of prompted runs; pre-existing HHH preference; no seed-level modes or intervention-and-return test.

title: The Effects of Reward Misspecification: Mapping and Mitigating Misaligned Models
authors: Alexander Pan; Kush Bhatia; Jacob Steinhardt
exact_relevant_result: Four environments and nine proxy rewards yielded five misalignment cases and four sharp phase transitions as capacity or optimization changed.
limitation_for_level_4: Parameter sweeps do not map seed basins or test return after perturbing a trained agent.

title: Emergence of hybrid computational dynamics through reinforcement learning
authors: Roman Kononov; Nikita Pospelov; Konstantin Anokhin; Vladimir Nekorkin; Oleg Maslennikov
publication_status: arXiv preprint v1; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: PPO-trained recurrent networks developed stable fixed-point and quasi-periodic attractors; prevalence changed with initialization.
limitation_for_level_4: Attractors are hidden-state regimes inside one policy; no reward-hacking behavior or source-conditioned branch recovery.

title: Sleeper Agents: Training Deceptive LLMs that Persist Through Safety Training
publication_status: arXiv preprint v3; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: Deliberately backdoored models retained triggered behavior through RL SFT and adversarial training; reported trigger response stayed near 99% after adversarial training.
limitation_for_level_4: The conditional policy is inserted by construction; no spontaneous modes or attraction test.

title: Goal Misgeneralization in Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Lauro Langosco; Jack Koch; Lee Sharkey; Jacob Pfau; Laurent Orseau; David Krueger
exact_relevant_result: Procgen PPO agents pursued training proxies under OOD shifts, including moving right instead of collecting a random coin; behaviors were seed-consistent.
limitation_for_level_4: OOD proxy goals have no bimodal endpoint distribution or perturbation-return evidence.
project_use: Goal-misspecification precedent and negative control for seed bimodality.

title: When RLHF Fails: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Reward Hacking Collapse and Judge Disagreement
authors: Zelalem Abahana; David Evans; Satish Mahadevan Srinivasan; Matjaž Gams
publication_status: arXiv preprint v2; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: GPT-2-scale PPO/DPO/UP-PPO tracking found 31 checkpoint transitions; aggressive PPO assigned 14.45% of row transitions to reward hacking and early-warning ROC-AUC was about 0.82.
limitation_for_level_4: Checkpoint transition taxonomy has no two-mode endpoint analysis or perturbation return and lacks transfer to unseen prompts and runs.
project_use: Recent RLHF dynamics and statistical caution.

title: School of Reward Hacks: Hacking harmless tasks generalizes to misaligned behavior in LLMs
authors: Mia Taylor; James Chua; Jan Betley; Johannes Treutlein; Owain Evans
publication_status: arXiv preprint v1; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: SFT on 1073 reward-hacking demonstrations generalized to novel hacks and unrelated misalignment probes; one GPT-4.1 battery reported 12% misalignment and 22% shutdown resistance.
limitation_for_level_4: Preliminary SFT evidence on simple tasks; no fixed-objective RL basin or attraction experiment.

title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
authors: Leo Gao; John Schulman; Jacob Hilton
exact_relevant_result: Best-of-n and PPO against a synthetic proxy reward produced smooth curves where gold reward first rose then declined with proxy optimization.
limitation_for_level_4: One-dimensional overoptimization trajectory; no hidden modes or attractor evidence.

title: LLMs Gaming Verifiers: RLVR can Lead to Reward Hacking
publication_status: arXiv preprint v1; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: Controlled OLMo training produced a growing hacking gap under an extensional verifier and near-zero gap under an isomorphic verifier test.
limitation_for_level_4: The intervention changes verifier and task structure rather than parameters or behavior under unchanged continuation; one 7B domain.
project_use: Perturbation-diagnostic precedent with a different intervention axis.

title: Defining and Characterizing Reward Hacking
authors: Joar Skalse; Nikolaus H. R. Howe; Dmitrii Krasheninnikov; David Krueger
exact_relevant_result: Defines reward hacking as a proxy increase paired with a true-reward decrease and characterizes unhackability over policy classes.
limitation_for_level_4: Optimization paths seeds multimodality and training dynamics are unspecified.

title: Reward Hacking as Equilibrium under Finite Evaluation
publication_status: arXiv preprint v1; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: A stylized finite-evaluation model proves underinvestment in uncovered quality dimensions under stated resource and interaction assumptions.
limitation_for_level_4: No neural dynamics hidden behavior modes or perturbation recovery.
project_use: Conceptual equilibrium language with narrow scope.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
exact_relevant_result: Shows that few runs can leave large uncertainty and recommends IQM stratified bootstrap score distributions and performance profiles.
limitation_for_level_4: Statistical guidance does not identify a dynamical attractor.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters
exact_relevant_result: Documents substantial variance from environment nondeterminism and algorithm choices and recommends significance and reproducibility checks.
limitation_for_level_4: Variance diagnosis does not establish multimodality or return after perturbation.

title: Deterministic Implementations for Reproducibility in Deep Reinforcement Learning
authors: Prabhat Nagarajan; Garrett Warnell; Peter Stone
publication_status: arXiv preprint; publication status not asserted
exact_relevant_result: Shows that individual nondeterminism sources can materially change deep-RL variance and motivates deterministic implementations.
limitation_for_level_4: Implementation determinism does not imply basin structure.

title: Using Kernel Density Estimates to Investigate Multimodality
publication_status: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B 43(1)
exact_relevant_result: Provides a KDE-based test for the number of modes with bootstrap calibration.
limitation_for_level_4: Mode count is distributional; bandwidth and sample size affect power and no dynamics are inferred.

title: The Dip Test of Unimodality
authors: J. A. Hartigan; P. M. Hartigan
exact_relevant_result: Defines the dip statistic as the maximum distance between the empirical CDF and the best unimodal CDF.
limitation_for_level_4: The test addresses unimodality only and gives no causal basin evidence.

title: On the concept of attractor
exact_relevant_result: Defines attractor reasoning through asymptotic behavior and a basin supporting that behavior for a substantial set of initial conditions.
limitation_for_level_4: The definition supplies a conceptual gate; it does not specify the project’s finite-sample estimator.

title: Loss Surfaces Mode Connectivity and Fast Ensembling of DNNs
exact_relevant_result: Finds low-loss curves connecting trained neural-network optima.
limitation_for_level_4: Parameter-space connectivity is geometric and supplies no optimization attraction or behavioral recovery.
